## Definition
The hierarchical interconnection architecture combining wafer-scale integration with chiplet-based modularity, enabling dynamic topology reconfiguration across multiple scales. It provides the physical backbone for TCC, allowing scalable and flexible network topologies that are essential for implementing spatiotemporal computing paradigms.
